mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DIARY WHERE DIARY_STATUS = 'N'

SELECT D.DIARY_NO AS diaryNo , D.DIARY_TITLE AS diaryTitle , D.DIARY_CONTENT AS diaryContent , D.CREATED_DATE AS createdDate , D.COUNT AS count , D.DIARY_STATUS AS diaryStatus , D.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo , M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName , M.EMAIL AS email , D.SCHEDULE_NO AS scheduleNo , D.TRAVEL_NO AS travelNo , D.UPDATED_DATE AS updatedDate FROM TB_DIARY D JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON D.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO ORDER BY D.CREATED_DATE DESC

SELECT D.DIARY_NO AS diaryNo , D.DIARY_TITLE AS diaryTitle , D.DIARY_CONTENT AS diaryContent , D.CREATED_DATE AS createdDate , D.COUNT AS count , D.DIARY_STATUS AS diaryStatus , D.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo , D.SCHEDULE_NO AS scheduleNo , D.TRAVEL_NO AS travelNo , M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName , M.EMAIL AS email , D.UPDATED_DATE AS updatedDate FROM TB_DIARY D JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON D.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE D.DIARY_NO = #{diaryNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_DIARY SET DIARY_STATUS = #{diaryStatus} , UPDATED_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE DIARY_NO = #{diaryNo}
mapper.select: SELECT IMAGE_NO AS imageNo , IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl , ORIGINAL_NAME AS originalName , SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder , DIARY_NO AS diaryNo FROM TB_DIARY_IMAGE WHERE DIARY_NO = #{diaryNo} ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC
